description: Full Australian Register of Therapeutic Goods (ARTG) record for one entry, by ARTG ID (LicenceId, from artg_search). Returns sponsor, every active/excipient ingredient with strength, dosage form, route of administration, standard/specific indications, status and start date, and links to the Product Information (PI) and Consumer Medicine Information (CMI) documents. Example: artg_entry({ id: "10109" }). Keyless.
name: artg_entry
